## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("tidymodel")
#library("tidyverse")
#library("tidyverse")
```

Looking at the Data

```{r}
financials = read.csv("/cloud/project/airline_financials.csv")
financials
orders = read.csv("/cloud/project/fleet_orders.csv")
orders
incidents = read.csv("/cloud/project/aviation_incidents.csv")
incidents
traffic = read.csv("/cloud/project/passenger_traffic.csv")
traffic
route = read.csv("/cloud/project/route_performance.csv")
route
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
